title: Gilead Sciences, Inc. (NASDAQ: GILD) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: Gilead Sciences (GILD) is a high-margin drug maker with $9.46B in FY25 free cash flow. Its core HIV drug Biktarvy holds U.S. patent protection until April 2036, while Yeztugo is scaling fast. At $167.54 in a weak market tape, we rate the stock WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT and bid at $156.82-$160.00. Our base target is $195 with a $139.82 stop, or traders can use a Feb 2027 $165/$180 call spread.
holding_rationale: Verified 0 shares held across Charles Schwab and Robinhood as of 2026-11-18. Because CMP ($167.54) sits +5.07% above the 10-week EMA ($159.45) in an S&P 500 Downtrend (43.6% breadth >50DMA, 8 distribution days), buying equity at CMP yields only 0.99:1 asymmetry to the $195.00 base target vs the $139.82 stop. We keep 100% of earmarked capital in cash and wait for a pullback into $156.82-$160.00 (1.73:1 asymmetry).

holding_alerts.instruction: Initiate starter equity position via staged limit orders at $159.50 and $157.00 with a hard invalidation stop at $139.82.
